name: verify_playable_ad
description: Boot-smoke a self-contained playable-ad index.html against the frozen contract (exactly one <canvas>, no external/remote resources, no forbidden network/storage/eval APIs, and the window.__smokeReady boot hook). Returns ok=false with concrete problems to feed a repair. A game that passes is deployable into the engines/web freeform genre.

html_path.description: Sandbox-relative path to the game's index.html
